description: Defines an enumeration CalendarFrequencyType representing different calendar frequency types (INVALID, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY) with utility methods for conversion and property checks.

classes.name: CalendarFrequencyType
classes.description: Enumeration for calendar frequency types with conversion utilities.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the frequency type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the frequency type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding CalendarFrequencyType.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding CalendarFrequencyType, defaults to INVALID.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum value among frequency types.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum value among frequency types.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant as string.

methods.name: isWeekly
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is weekly.

methods.name: isMonthly
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is monthly.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is invalid.
